headline: Emerge Legal advises Nahar Industrial Enterprises on its real estate expansion

detail: Nahar Industrial Enterprises Limited, the listed Ludhiana company promoted by the Nahar (OWM) Group, has entered real estate development, putting land it has held for decades to commercial use. The programme runs across plotted industrial development, warehousing and logistics, and organised commercial space. Emerge Legal acted for Nahar Industrial Enterprises across the expansion. The firm verified title to the subject parcels, advised on the development and holding structure adopted.
